items.question: Do I need an account to use the tools?
items.answer: Yes. Each request is counted against your account, so the dashboard needs a sign-in to track your remaining free requests.

items.question: What is included in the Free plan?
items.answer: Five AI requests in total, spread across any of the seven tools. Image tools count as one request per upload.

items.question: Which image files can I upload?
items.answer: JPG, PNG, and GIF up to 2 MB. Background removal returns a PNG with the transparency preserved.

items.question: What happens to my uploaded images?
items.answer: Images are processed by Cloudinary and the result is returned to you. Nothing is published to a public gallery.

items.question: Can I use the output in my own work?
items.answer: Yes. Generated articles, titles, code, and cleaned-up images are yours to keep and publish.
